[Unit]
Description=The udpstp bench round's dead-man switch: power off at the round's deadline
After=systemd-logind.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

for _ in $(seq 90); do [ -s /run/systemd/shutdown/scheduled ] && break; sleep 2; done; [ -s /run/systemd/shutdown/scheduled ] || exit 1; tr '\n' ' ' < /run/systemd/shutdown/scheduled; for _ in $(seq 15); do systemctl is-enabled --quiet udpstp-bench-dead-man.service && break; sleep 2; done; systemctl is-enabled --quiet udpstp-bench-dead-man.service && [ -x /usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man ] && echo "at every boot until $(sed -n 's/^deadline=//p' /usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man)"; exit 0

#!/bin/sh
# The udpstp bench round's dead-man switch, at every boot.
deadline=1790018000
left=$(( ($deadline - $(date +%s) + 59) / 60 ))
if [ "$left" -gt 0 ]; then exec shutdown -P "+$left"; fi
exec systemctl --no-block poweroff

if [ "$left" -gt 0 ]; then exec shutdown -P "+$left"; fi
exec systemctl --no-block poweroff
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man
cat > /etc/systemd/system/udpstp-bench-dead-man.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=The udpstp bench round's dead-man switch: power off at the round's deadline
After=systemd-logind.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl enable udpstp-bench-dead-man.service
install -d -m 700 -o ubuntu -g ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.ssh
echo "k" >> /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys

chmod 600 /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys

deadline=1779189361
left=$(( ($deadline - $(date +%s) + 59) / 60 ))
if [ "$left" -gt 0 ]; then exec shutdown -P "+$left"; fi
exec systemctl --no-block poweroff

# The udpstp bench round's dead-man switch, at every boot.
deadline=1739909562
left=$(( ($deadline - $(date +%s) + 59) / 60 ))
if [ "$left" -gt 0 ]; then exec shutdown -P "+$left"; fi
exec systemctl --no-block poweroff
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man
cat > /etc/systemd/system/udpstp-bench-dead-man.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=The udpstp bench round's dead-man switch: power off at the round's deadline
After=systemd-logind.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/udpstp-bench-dead-man

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl enable udpstp-bench-dead-man.service
install -d -m 700 -o ubuntu -g ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.ssh
echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAA test" >> /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/ubuntu/.ssh/authorized_keys
